claims.text: The rocket's stages were designed entirely by Wernher von Braun's team at Redstone Arsenal, working without industrial contractors.
claims.correction: Von Braun's team worked at the Marshall Space Flight Center in Huntsville, and the stages were built by industrial contractors: Boeing (S-IC), North American (S-II), Douglas (S-IVB).
